description: This is a Python source file defining an abstract base test class for Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) ingestion testing. It contains abstract methods to be implemented by subclasses, methods to perform ingestion and query tests, and utilizes the litellm SDK for interacting with language models and vector stores.

classes.name: BaseRAGTest
classes.description: An abstract base class that enforces common RAG ingestion tests across different providers. It requires subclasses to implement specific methods for obtaining ingestion options and querying vector stores.

methods.name: RAGIngestOptions get_base_ingest_options(self)
methods.description: Abstract method to return provider-specific ingestion options.

methods.name: Optional[Dict[str,Any]] query_vector_store( self, vector_store_id: str, query: str, )
methods.description: Abstract method for querying the vector store to verify ingestion results.

methods.name: str get_unique_filename(self, prefix: str = "test")
methods.description: Generates a unique filename for test documents with a specified prefix.

methods.name: test_basic_ingest(self)
methods.description: Asynchronous pytest test method to ingest a text file and verify the response.

methods.name: test_ingest_and_query(self)
methods.description: Asynchronous pytest test method to perform ingestion followed by querying the vector store to verify the document was indexed.
